_doc: Machine-checkable update endpoints for `python -m datasets.update_monitor` (docs/urbanos/DATA_INGESTION_ARCHITECTURE.md §6). Read-only metadata probes: HEAD, a CKAN package_show, a STAC search with limit=1, a GitHub latest-release query, or a Geofabrik region page. Nothing is ever downloaded or replaced; a newer upstream is recorded as an update_check row with result 'update_available' for a reviewer. Keys are registry dataset ids. 'baseline' says where the acquired state is read from: 'manifest' = the http headers / CKAN fields the raw manifest recorded for the same URL (latest raw/<dataset_id>/<date>/manifest.json); 'active_version' = the registry's active version; otherwise the first update check recorded for that URL is the reference. Entries with method 'none' are listed so the catalogue can state WHY a source is not machine-checkable. Written 2026-11-13 IST from the raw manifests on disk.

osm_geofabrik_western_zone.note: Geofabrik robots.txt disallows *.osm.pbf, state.txt and *updates* for all agents: the region HTML page ('contains all OSM data up to …') is read instead; the .pbf is never probed.

esa_worldcover_2021_v200.note: Detects a change to the acquired 2021 v200 tile only; a new WorldCover release would be published under a new path (not discoverable by HEAD).

ms_global_ml_buildings.note: Index of the 2026-08-13 release only; a later release is published under a new dated path (not discoverable by HEAD).

nasadem_pc.reason: The Planetary Computer blob refuses anonymous requests (HTTP 409 'Public access is not permitted on this storage account', seen 2026-11-13 IST); it needs a Planetary Computer SAS token, which the monitor does not request. NASADEM v001 is a fixed product (SRTM, February 2000).

nwdp_india_wris.note: NWDP robots.txt Crawl-Delay 10 s. The IMD district rainfall resource is re-published daily (a daily series, not a revision).

opencity_pune.note: One package_show per CKAN dataset the manifest lists (ckan_dataset); acquired resource last_modified (ckan_last_modified_utc) compared per resource. OpenCity serves a Cloudflare challenge to scripted clients (recorded at acquisition): a refusal is recorded as an error and never bypassed; check in a browser.

sentinel2_l2a_earthsearch.note: Time series: a newer scene over Pune almost always exists (5-day revisit). 'update available' means a newer acquisition date, not a revision of the acquired scenes.

imd_gridded_rainfall_025.note: The yearly grids are served by a POST form (not probed); the listing page's headers are the only cheap signal.

pmc_autodcr_geoserver_probe.note: Capabilities metadata only; layer data not acquired (permission requested, MISSING_DATA_AND_COLLECTION_PLAN).

mendeley_pune_2023_counts.note: Version-1 page; a new Mendeley version gets a new URL (…/2).

observed_counts_pune_west_2026.note: The Zenodo record is the cross-check source (Kureshi et al. 2026) of these counts. Zenodo robots.txt disallows /api for all agents: the record page is probed (Crawl-delay 10 s).

hbefa4_sumo_coefficients.note: Coefficients ship with SUMO; a new SUMO release may change them. SUMO publishes git tags, not GitHub releases (releases/latest = 404): the tags API is read. The SUMO version the coefficients were taken from is not recorded in the registry (UNKNOWN), so the first check is the reference.

chirps_v2_climateserv.reason: ClimateSERV serves per-request jobs (no stable resource to probe); CHIRPS extends daily. Re-run the chirps pipeline for newer days. data.chc.ucsb.edu robots.txt disallows all agents.

soilgrids_250m_v2.reason: WCS GetCoverage computes a coverage (a probe would be a download); SoilGrids 2.0 is a fixed release.

bhuvan_wms_samples.reason: Rendered WMS map images (pictures), not data; nothing to compare.

cesium_ion_imagery.reason: Streamed under the Cesium ion ToS; never stored, no version to compare.

cesium_world_terrain.reason: Streamed under the Cesium ion ToS; never stored, no version to compare.

cmp2008_river_screenline.reason: Values transcribed from the 2008 CMP PDF (historical document).
